clips.full: The man leaning on the table speaks quietly across it, in a warm, unhurried, privately educated southern English accent: Problem is eyes. Two thousand people outside that bank tomorrow. He keeps his elbows on the table and his eyes on the other man. Fixed camera, one continuous shot, normal speed. Sound: his voice, and the heavy rhythmic thump of a big printing press in the room. No music. Thanks.

The man in the red tie, grinning, says to the other man, in an earnest north London English accent: Leave the people to us. Then they clink their glasses once and drink. Fixed camera, one continuous shot, normal speed. Sound: his voice, the clink of glasses, the heavy rhythmic thump of a big printing press in the room. No music. Thanks.

The finger presses the key under it down once, firmly, and lifts away. Nothing else moves. Fixed camera, one continuous shot, normal speed. Sound: one loud plastic keyboard click in a silent room. No dialogue. No music. Thanks.
